name: codex-novel
description: Create guided Novel projects, then bootstrap, write, review, and transactionally publish local long-form fiction through the Novel CLI.

interface.longDescription: Codex Novel installs and loads the selected project's Codex boundaries in place, initializes approved Intent, runs bounded writing and review, navigates exact historical prose, and publishes immutable Draft revisions only after the author approves the exact digest.
defaultPrompt: Use the Novel creation skills to load the selected project contract in place, initialize Intent, write, review, and publish through explicit project and digest boundaries.
